messages:
incident-bot: INCIDENT ALERT — Elevated 5xx error rate observed from model variant `omega-experimental-v3` in us-east-1. Error rate spiked to ~4.2% over baseline, latency also increased. Auto-scaling thrash detected. Paging primary oncall. @channel

mia: I'm on pager. seeing the spike in SLO dashboards. rolling 1m window shows errors tied to long tail token lengths. :thinking_face:

alex: tagging runtime — could be kv-cache pressure or a kernel mismatch after the last floor-deploy. thomas, any recent kernel/quant changes in that shard?

thomas: pushed a micro-optimization earlier for kernel selection. not expecting functional changes, but I see higher mem pressure on the hosts serving `omega-experimental-v3`. starting a quick check on instance logs.

jordan: quick customer note — Support flagged 8 customers in EU seeing 5xx on rewrite calls, two of them enterprise. lucy can you confirm impact and reach out if we need to page account teams?

lucy: confirmed. outreach in progress to 2 enterprise contacts, advising degraded performance. no escalations yet.

mia: mitigation plan proposal: 1) apply emergency keywise soft-rate-limits for heavy keys 2) reduce traffic percent to `omega-experimental-v3` by 90% redirecting to `v2-stable-2025` 3) pin stable variant for all enterprise customers until we validate. any objections?

alex: +1. recommend also temporarily lowering max tokens for the problematic route (rewrite) to reduce long-tail token pressure.

thomas: agree. if mem pressure is root cause, reducing tokens and offloading to v2 will buy time while I revert the kernel tweak.

mia: executing actions now. first step: apply keywise soft quota for heavy API keys to 60r/min and 1 concurrent request. doing a staged roll: 10% keys -> 50% -> all.

ops-bot: ACTION: applied keywise quota to 10% of heavy keys. (quota_id: q_yg4k) :white_check_mark:

mia: next, reducing route max_tokens for `rewrite` to 256 (was 2048) in live config.

ops-bot: DEPLOY: config patch pushed to route `rewrite` (max_tokens: 256). change rolled to 3 regions, will propagate in ~30s.

alex: starting traffic shift: initiating traffic-shear (gradual weight change) to move 90% of traffic off `omega-experimental-v3` to `v2-stable-2025`. using 10% step every 30s. snippet: ```
# traffic control
POST /internal/traffic/adjust
{ "variant": "omega-experimental-v3", "weight_delta": -90 }
```

ops-bot: TRAFFIC EVENT: weight change queued. initiating stepwise shift.

thomas: I'm rolling back the kernel micro-opt on the affected shard and re-scheduling the runtime with extra mem headroom. will post ETA.

mia: lucy — please update the 2 enterprise customers that we've shifted them to a pinned stable variant to avoid further degradation. mention expected ETA ~20-30m for verification.

lucy: done — sent messages and copied account SREs. no immediate escalations.

alex: monitoring metrics: error rate dropping in us-east-1 as traffic shifts. current 5xx at 1.1% and trending down.

incident-bot: NOTE: auto fallback policy triggered for several requests — successful fallbacks to `v2-stable-2025` reported.

mia: thomas, status on kernel revert?

thomas: revert complete on 3 primary hosts, warming caches. memory pressure down ~35%. I'll keep one host running the experimental kernel to capture logs for repro. ETA to finish roll: 11m.

alex: recommend keeping `omega-experimental-v3` disabled for public traffic until we run a short smoke on internal canary set and verify token-length tails are stable.

mia: agreed. ops-bot — please set variant `omega-experimental-v3` to disabled for external routing and keep internal canaries at 0.5% for 30m. then we can flesh out a postmortem and rollback plan.

ops-bot: ACTION: set variant `omega-experimental-v3` external_routing=false; internal_canary=0.5%. (req_id: r_88pq)

jordan: logging note: capture sample of failed requests (keep first 100k) and stash to s3://rdw-incident-dumps/2360012345/ for evaluation. include token-length distribution.

ops-bot: BACKUP: sample capture started, ETA 12m.

mia: impact assessment: degraded for ~14 minutes, affected ~12 customers, 2 enterprise. primary mitigation applied (traffic moved & variant disabled). no broad data loss. we'll keep enterprise pinned to v2-stable-2025 for 48h unless they request revert.

lucy: account teams notified and monitoring follow-ups scheduled.

alex: closing loop on immediate mitigations: quotas, token cap, traffic shift, variant disable. next steps: postmortem owner?

mia: I'll own the incident and coordinate postmortem. thomas + alex will provide runtime and infra root cause analysis. jordan to add metrics artifact. lucy to include customer communications.

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: error rate back to baseline in affected regions. keeping watch for 2h.

mia: thanks everyone. final note: do not re-enable `omega-experimental-v3` without an explicit rollout plan and a canary harness with token-length coverage. :lock:

-- end of thread --
